scope: Proposition 7.2 (Address input from the companion) of the manuscript “Spectral convergence for critical FK–Ising planar maps” (preprints/Spectral-convergence-for-critical-FK-Ising-planar-maps-October-5-2026/spectral-convergence-critical-fk-ising-planar-maps.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eeb5895c7058765f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 56-57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the marker systems just described, with fixed b, R, K, the following statements hold. (i) If ck is the number of components of the union of the two colored graphs, then ck ≤ bk + Dk, ek ≥ mk − ck. Moreover EΞ X k Dk ≤ CK,RMjump. If the bases lie in an interval of length Crm(N), then EΞ P k≤N/ℓR (bk − 1) ≤ CC,R. (ii) For each ε > 0, a fixed sufficiently large R gives, with conditional grid probability at least 7/8, disjoint regular sampling slots after deletion of at most CRMterm + εTocc node occurrences. For each sufficiently small fixed ε > 0, R and the deletion tolerances may be fixed so that every such code c obeys PW m {c is realized} ≤ exp{−ϑℓRRrk + εℓRTocc + CR,εMterm}. (7.4) Realization includes all its actual chord constraints. The bound is uniform in the fixed grid displacement and in the exact chord endpoints inside the recorded cells, once the minimum sampling radius diverges. 56 (iii) For each fixed displacement and fixed augmented distinct probe depths, and every 0 < η ≤ K, the number of decorated codes with occupancy Tocc = t is at most the exponential of (ℓR + C0 + η)t + KPN log(K/η) + CPN K log(K + 1) + O(1). (7.5) If the depth list itself is encoded, add log JR+1 PN  ; our independent mesh phases are instead held as side information. (iv) Let ∆(Ξ) count generations at which the partition of the active markers into shifted cells differs from the grid-independent partition obtained by joining consecutive active positions with gap < δk. Then EΞ[∆(Ξ) | markers] ≤ 2R R − 1 Mterm. At a generation with equal partitions the entire colored graph and its base labels agree up to cell names. For PN = O(N/L), take the error tolerances and R fixed first, then N and the minimum units to infinity with L → ∞ and L = o(N). The terminal, jump, and structural errors above are o(N) for every fixed K. One may subsequently let K = Km → ∞ sufficiently slowly, with Km log(KmL) L −→ 0, Km log(2 b Cm) L −→ 0, where 2 b Cmm is a growing enclosure length, and with the composed exploration depth below Dmax m . The second condition pays for its extra address ancestors. The integrated jump error remains o(N), and each previously fixed minimum-unit threshold is retained.
